blocks.name: Scroll Gallery
blocks.description: A sticky scroll-driven gallery with a parallax image strip on the right and animated destination info on the left, connected by a flight-path arc divider.

variations.name: parallax-strip
variations.description: Five travel destinations revealed through a sticky scroll. The right panel stacks images in a weighted parallax strip; the left panel slides in destination info driven by scroll position.
variations.previewHint: Scroll down to navigate through destinations
features: Lenis smooth scroll drives the entire layout via a single useScroll hook
Image strip uses scale + Y + rotate transforms so each image slots into a weighted parallax stack
Arc SVG divider renders a dashed flight path; a plane icon follows via offset-path and flips direction based on scroll velocity
Left panel text slots use AnimatePresence mode='wait' spring transitions — no layout shift
Stat values animate with useSpring so numbers count up smoothly on each destination change

blocks.name: SubItem Navbar
blocks.description: A morphing pill navbar anchored at the bottom. Each tab expands into either a chip filter row or any custom ReactNode panel — pass a login form, a settings menu, or anything else.

variations.name: subitem-navbar
variations.description: Tabs expand a panel above the bar via a spring-driven height animation. Panels are either a chip filter list (subs) or any React node (panel). LoginPanel is a named export for use as a panel slot.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of nav items passed to the bar.

props.name: items[].label
props.description: Tab label shown below the icon.

props.name: items[].icon
props.description: HugeIcons icon component rendered in the tab button.

props.name: items[].subs
props.description: Chip filter list. Mutually exclusive with panel.

props.name: items[].subs[].label
props.description: Chip label text.

props.name: items[].subs[].icon
props.description: Chip icon.

props.name: items[].panel
props.description: Custom panel rendered when the tab is active. Mutually exclusive with subs. Pass <LoginPanel /> or any component.

variations.previewHint: Tap any tab to expand its panel — Work/About/Journal show chip filters, Login shows a form
features: Discriminated union props: each NavItem has either subs (chip list) or panel (any ReactNode)
LoginPanel is a named export with self-contained email/password/showPassword state
Blur overlay rendered inside the component — just place BottomNavbar inside a relative container
useMeasure drives submenu height so the pill expands to exactly fit any panel
prefers-reduced-motion: all spring and blur transitions collapse to instant

blocks.name: Profile Card
blocks.description: An avatar that morphs into a full profile card using shared layout animation. Click the avatar to expand; click anywhere to dismiss.

variations.name: navbar
variations.description: Small avatar in a phone frame expands via layoutId into a floating profile card with staggered menu groups.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name shown in the expanded card header.

props.name: email
props.description: Email shown below the name in the expanded card header.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Avatar slot rendered both collapsed (36px) and expanded (42px). Defaults to DefaultAvatar. Pass an , next/image, or any node.

props.name: menuItems
props.description: Flat list of menu rows. Defaults to the built-in Profile/Community/Subscription/Settings/Help/Sign out set.

props.name: menuItems[].label
props.description: Row label text.

props.name: menuItems[].icon
props.description: HugeIcons icon component rendered in the row.

props.name: menuItems[].badge
props.description: Trailing slot — pass a count pill, a PRO badge, or any node.

props.name: menuItems[].active
props.description: Highlights the row background.

props.name: menuItems[].onClick
props.description: Click handler for the row.

props.name: menuItems[].dividerAfter
props.description: Renders a full-width divider below this row — used to group rows without needing a nested array.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the root wrapper.

variations.previewHint: Tap the avatar in the top-right to expand the profile card
features: Shared layout animation (layoutId) morphs the avatar from 40px to a 310px card — no clone, one continuous motion
Avatar is a separate layoutId child so it independently transitions size and position
Flat menuItems array with a per-row dividerAfter flag — grouping without a nested array shape
Avatar, badges, and click handlers are all composable slots per menu item, same pattern as SubItem Navbar's panel slot
Dismiss overlay is scoped inside the phone frame so clicks outside the card close it
PRO badge, community badge, and active row highlight are all composable per menu item

blocks.name: Morphing Image Effect
blocks.description: A click-driven 3-stage animation where a typographic split ('P' | image | 'ST') morphs between states — the image pill reshapes and the text scales on each click.

variations.name: default
variations.description: Three-stage morph: thumbnail pill → landscape card → portrait card. Text scales inversely as the image grows.
variations.previewHint: Click anywhere to advance through the 3 stages
features: CSS t-resize class owns width/height transitions so layout reflow stays on the compositor thread
Framer Motion animate handles borderRadius and rotate — no layout thrashing
Stage label uses AnimatePresence mode='wait' with blur cross-fade
prefers-reduced-motion: t-resize transition is disabled via media query
Single Image element reused across all stages — no clone, no re-mount

blocks.name: Category Ticker
blocks.description: Auto-scrolling vertical word ticker with kinetic typography. A fixed arrow pointer highlights the active item as the list cycles on a timed interval.

variations.name: vertical-marquee
variations.description: Auto-scrolling vertical word ticker with kinetic typography. A fixed arrow pointer highlights the active item as the list cycles on a timed interval.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of strings to cycle through in the ticker

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color of the entire section

props.name: activeColor
props.description: Color of the active (highlighted) word and arrow

props.name: inactiveColor
props.description: Color of the surrounding inactive words

props.name: intervalMs
props.description: Milliseconds between each word advance

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Pixel height of each row; font sizes scale proportionally

variations.previewHint: Watch the ticker cycle automatically — it loops seamlessly on a timed interval
features: Seamless infinite loop — snaps back to start with zero-duration transition so the jump is invisible
Active word slides right to clear the fixed arrow, then scales up in size and weight
Font sizes derive from rowHeight so the layout never breaks when the row size changes
Respects prefers-reduced-motion — all transitions collapse to duration 0
Fully prop-driven — swap items, colors, speed, and row height without touching source

variations.name: onboarding-steps
variations.description: Multi-step onboarding form with a vertical ticker step indicator on the left and an animated MCQ question panel on the right.

props.name: steps
props.description: Array of { label, question, options[] } objects defining each step

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Callback fired when the user submits the final step, receives answers keyed by step index

variations.previewHint: Select an answer, then click the arrow to advance through each step
features: Vertical ticker syncs with the active step — same scroll mechanic as the Vertical Marquee variation
Question panel slides in/out with direction-aware animation (forward vs back)
Next button is disabled until an option is selected — no accidental skips
Arrow icon swaps to a checkmark on the final step with a spring micro-animation
Completion screen fades in after the last step is submitted
Fully driven by the steps prop — swap questions without touching source
Respects prefers-reduced-motion — all transitions collapse to duration 0
